_doc: Overrides for scripts/update-prices.mjs. price_url: page to check instead of tool.price_url/source. extra_sources: additional OFFICIAL vendor URLs (count as independent sources). data_fixes: one-time data corrections applied only when publishing (DRY_RUN=false), and only if the current value equals 'from'. converted: tools whose stored USD is converted from a local currency (manual check only). render_clicks: exact visible labels Playwright clicks before reading the rendered page (tabs only, never sign-in or consent bypass).

fetch_profile._comment: Reference price = US price in USD. Defaults for every tool: locale en-US, timezone America/New_York, Accept-Language en-US. VEED prices by IP country (no public URL/currency parameter found in its pricing page; we do not spoof geo headers or call its internal API), so the US GitHub runner + US profile sees the US page.

cleanvoice._why: page has an EUR/USD toggle; static HTML defaults to EUR, rendered en-US shows USD; clicking USD pins it even outside the US

pitch._why: Framer page: static HTML is EUR (€10), currency is set client-side after hydration; no currency URL param/cookie found (?currency=usd, /pricing/usd, /en-us/pricing fail)

render_variants._comment: click sequences rendered in order; the first must be the monthly-billing view (price_usd), later ones e.g. the yearly view (price_yearly_usd). currency_click from fetch_profile is prepended.
